description: This file implements a Pipedrive CRM service class with methods for creating, updating, deleting contacts and events, handling OAuth authentication, and integrating with Pipedrive API.

classes.name: PipedriveCrmService
classes.description: A class implementing CRM interface for Pipedrive, managing contacts and activities with OAuth authentication.

methods.name: requestPipedrive
methods.description: Performs API requests to Pipedrive with proper authorization.

methods.name: createContacts
methods.description: Creates new contacts in Pipedrive from provided input.

methods.name: getContacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts from Pipedrive based on email addresses.

methods.name: getMeetingBody
methods.description: Generates the body text for a meeting activity.

methods.name: createPipedriveActivity
methods.description: Creates a new activity (meeting) in Pipedrive.

methods.name: updateActivity
methods.description: Updates an existing activity in Pipedrive.

methods.name: handleEventCreation
methods.description: Handles creation of a calendar event in Pipedrive.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event in Pipedrive.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event in Pipedrive.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event in Pipedrive.

methods.name: getAvailability
methods.description: Returns availability data; currently not implemented.
